subject: One main-repo check for both dispatch paths (HEAD / push / porcelain / hard_block.dirs) replaces the #127 attribution guard; auto-fix.sh shrinks
objective: Per D-064 (main-line interpretation): four before/after comparisons - main HEAD, origin refs, main-repo working tree (porcelain + content hash of dirty files), files under hard_block.dirs - live in one shared module and run for both the headless rounds (auto-fix exit 8 as today) and the 'auto-fix.sh --prepare' in-session subagent rounds (apply.sh exit 7 on receipt). No per-commit attribution: HEAD moving forward while a main-line land event happened in the window is recorded, not blocked. The #127 chain walk and the #144 local-branch check go; round-1 setup shared by --prepare and the headless first round exists once; scripts/auto-fix.sh ends smaller than base (goal: below 2,959, D-063 6).
acceptance: A1 One shared Python module under scripts/ (name chosen by the worker, listed in EVIDENCE) holds the whole check: 'snapshot' (ts; main HEAD 40 hex; 'git status --porcelain=v1 -z --untracked-files=all' of the main repo with a content hash per listed path; every file under board/config.json hard_block.dirs (~ expanded, relative to the main repo) with its hash; 'git ls-remote origin' refs, bounded by a timeout) and 'compare' (snapshot vs now). It is the only copy: scripts/auto-fix.sh and scripts/apply.sh call it and contain no porcelain walk, hard_block.dirs walk or ls-remote of their own.

A2 Compare rules. (a) HEAD unchanged -> ok. HEAD moved forward (snapshot HEAD is an ancestor of current main) AND the events file has at least one land.pass, or land.fail with stage=push, whose ts is at or after the snapshot ts -> recorded, not blocked (one line naming old..new short shas and the land stamps). The commits in old..new are NOT checked one by one (D-064: no per-commit attribution). HEAD moved with no such event, or snapshot HEAD no longer an ancestor of main (reset / rewrite) -> reject. (b) origin: any remote ref created / moved / deleted -> reject, except refs/heads/main (and the HEAD symref) moving when (a) found a land event in the window. No 'origin' remote -> not compared, one line. ls-remote failing or timing out at either end -> one line 'push not compared', not a rejection. (c) working tree: a path whose porcelain status or hash differs -> reject, except the control plane (tickets / events / answers / reports as config resolves them, as today), the agent's own worktree / copy, and paths under guard_main_paths prefixes (default tickets/ docs/ memory/) which are recorded, not blocked (#128 A1 kept). (d) hard_block.dirs: any file created / changed / deleted -> reject, no exception, land events or not.

A3 Prepared path: 'auto-fix.sh <n> --prepare worker|verifier' writes the snapshot to '<round dir>/main-snapshot.json' (fix-t<n>/round1, verify-t<n>/round1) before printing the pointer; the pointer (fd 3 / stdout) is unchanged - extra messages go to stderr; no origin or unreachable origin does not fail prepare. apply.sh compares every main-snapshot.json it finds (worker: the round dir; verifier: the patch-verify's directory); any reject -> new exit code 7 BEFORE applying patch-verify, regenerating code-map or harvesting EVIDENCE (ticket JSON bytes and ticket branch head unchanged); stderr names the first offending item (sha range, ref or path) and says 'not received'. Recorded items -> one stdout line each, rc as base.
A4 No main-snapshot.json (hand-dispatched subagent, apply calls from headless rounds) -> apply prints one line that the main-repo comparison was not made and keeps its base behaviour and rc.

A5 Headless path: run_agent snapshots before each worker / verifier / batch-worker process and compares after it exits with the same module. A reject keeps today's outcome: auto-fix exit 8, ticket Blocked, owner main, attempt.failed reason=guard-violation, one decision page naming the items; the per-agent '<log stem>.guard.json' keeps its name and its 'violations' / 'main_side' keys so kept cases read it unchanged. Removed: the land_rows / land_segments / land_attribution chain walk (#127, #128 A4) and the refs/heads comparison of other local branches (#144): grep -rn 'land_attribution\|land_segments\|land_rows' scripts/ returns nothing.

A6 Shared setup exists once: prepare_worker and round_once's first round call one helper for round dir + first_round_packet + ticket worktree + Ready->Running; prepare_verifier and the headless verifier start call one helper for source choice + archive_copy + verifier_packet.

A7 Size: 'wc -l < scripts/auto-fix.sh' on the branch head < 3414 (base 277cf56, measured). Goal <= 2958 (D-063 6); if above, EVIDENCE says why in one sentence (D-064: '沒到的話，報告寫一句理由就好'). EVIDENCE records before/after wc -l of scripts/auto-fix.sh, scripts/apply.sh and the module. Comments narrating superseded history may go; comments giving a current reason stay.

A8 Cases that only pinned removed behaviour are deleted, not skipped (D-057 1), and listed in EVIDENCE: the attribution / chain / local-branch / land-segment verdict cases in tests/test_auto_fix.py TheGuardCatchesAgentsOutsideTheirCopy (e.g. test_127_a4_a_bare_commit_before_a_legal_land_is_named, test_127_a5_*, test_144_another_branch_moved_*, test_128_a4_*segment) and in verify/dispatch/test_ticket_115/127/128.py (whole file when nothing is left). Cases on land.sh's event shape stay green unchanged (land.sh is not changed): tests/test_land.py, verify/dispatch/test_ticket_127.py A1*, verify/dispatch/test_ticket_129.py A7. Cases on kept behaviour (porcelain incl. dirty-again hash, control plane, hard_block.dirs incl. ~ expansion, guard_main_paths prefixes, serial verifier guarded, a concurrent land, a land.start alone does not excuse a HEAD move) stay green with assertions unchanged.

A9 Docs follow: apply.sh header lists exit 7; auto-fix.sh header's exit 8 text states the four comparisons without attribution; docs/WORKFLOW.md item 8 (agent guard) and docs/DISPATCH-TEMPLATE.md lines naming refs/heads or attribution say the D-064 rule; docs/SESSION-START.md main-line dispatch line lists apply rc 7 with what the main line does (do not hand the round back to the subagent; read the named item and decide).
A10 As uid 0: 'python3 -m unittest discover -s tests' and 'python3 scripts/verify.py' are green; EVIDENCE records Ran counts and rc.
feature: Dispatch: one main-repo check for headless and --prepare rounds (D-064)
test_plan:
Expected values come from the fixture's own git / file operations (the test makes the commits, pushes and writes and knows their shas and paths) and from D-064's wording, never from the code under test. Layer: end-to-end through scripts/auto-fix.sh (--prepare and headless), scripts/apply.sh and the real 'sh scripts/land.sh docs' where named, in the existing tests/test_auto_fix.py fixtures (APreparedRoundIsHandedInByAnInSessionSubagent for the prepared path, TheGuardCatchesAgentsOutsideTheirCopy for headless). Cases go into those existing modules (D-056: no new ticket-numbered case files); verify.tags empty. Root (uid 0) safe: no chmod / mode-bit injection; 'origin' is a local bare repo made by the test; no network. New test lines must not contain the hard_block patterns (os.kill, killpg, pkill, 'kill -').

T1 (A3) prepare -> nothing moves -> apply rc 0; existing prepared-round cases green.
T2 (A2a) prepare -> the test runs 'sh scripts/land.sh docs "<msg>" tickets/<n>.json' once, then twice -> apply rc 0; stdout has the recorded line with the snapshot HEAD and current HEAD short shas; patch-verify commit on the branch as before.
T3 (A2a/A3) prepare -> 'git -C <root> commit --allow-empty -m stray' on main, no land events -> rc 7; stderr has 'not received' and the snapshot HEAD short sha; ticket JSON bytes and ticket branch head equal their values read before apply.
T4 (A2a, D-064 reversal of #127 A4) stray commit, then a docs landing -> rc 0 with the recorded line (no per-commit attribution).
T5 (A2a) 'git -C <root> reset --hard HEAD~1' after prepare -> rc 7.
T6 (A2b) fixture with a bare origin (main pushed before prepare): (a) 'git -C <worktree> push origin t<n>' -> rc 7 naming refs/heads/t<n>; (b) a docs landing (land.sh pushes main) -> rc 0; (c) 'git -C <worktree> push --force origin <ticket branch head>:refs/heads/main' (a sha not on local main) with no land event -> rc 7 naming refs/heads/main; (d) 'git remote set-url origin <missing path>' after prepare -> rc as base and a 'push not compared' line. No origin at all -> prepare rc 0, apply rc 0 with the not-compared line.
T7 (A2c) prepare, then in the main repo: untracked scripts/stray.txt -> rc 7 naming it; a file already dirty before prepare written again -> rc 7; docs/stray.md -> rc 0 + recorded line; 'ticket.py set <other ticket> …' -> rc 0.
T8 (A2d) config hard_block.dirs = [a temp dir outside the repo] with one file; change it after prepare -> rc 7; same change plus a docs landing in the window -> still rc 7.
T9 (A3) after prepare: fix-t<n>/round1/main-snapshot.json and verify-t<n>/round1/main-snapshot.json exist, their HEAD equals 'git rev-parse main' taken by the test before prepare; existing pointer assertions of the two prepare classes stay green unchanged.
T10 (A4) delete main-snapshot.json before apply -> rc 0 and the not-compared line.
T11 (A5) headless, existing guard fixture: fake worker commits on main (no land) -> exit 8, Blocked, owner main, one page; fake worker writes under hard_block.dirs -> exit 8; fake worker commits only on its branch while the test runs a docs landing -> received as before. Kept guard cases run unchanged.
T12 (A1/A5) grep -rn 'land_attribution\|land_segments\|land_rows' scripts/ -> empty; grep -c 'ls-remote' scripts/auto-fix.sh scripts/apply.sh -> 0 each; the module has it.
T13 (A6) grep: first_round_packet has one caller inside the shared helper; archive_copy + verifier_packet appear once in sequence.
T14 (A7) wc -l before/after in EVIDENCE.
T15 (A8/A10) full suite as uid 0 in batches under 590 s each; EVIDENCE lists deleted cases.
Mutations (not measured by the opener): M1 replace the land-event window with literal HEAD equality -> T2 red. M2 skip the remote comparison -> T6a red. M3 run the check after the patch-verify commit -> T3 'branch head unchanged' red. M4 exempt hard_block.dirs when a land is in the window -> T8 second half red. M5 restore per-commit attribution -> T4 red.
outline: Merged #153 + #154 (D-064). Rule = 主線解讀 of D-064 (docs/DECISIONS.md D-064, not yet confirmed by the user): four comparisons in one module for both paths; HEAD forward + land event in window = record. Why merged: the check, its headless wiring, guard deletion and the round-1 dedupe are one edit of auto-fix.sh; split = two workers on a 3.4k-line file and a period with two guards. #154 Cancelled. Measured: auto-fix.sh 3414 @277cf56; guard+chain 1347-1660 (314) + guard_stop 398-447; prepare_worker 3264, prepare_verifier 3298; origin has non-script branches (t146-cloud etc.), only land.sh pushes (main). Estimate ~2,960 (not measured). Docs: WORKFLOW 8, DISPATCH-TEMPLATE, SESSION-START. land.sh unchanged. Depends #152 (test_auto_fix prepare classes). complex; needs_verifier=true (new receipt contract). Opener calls: guard_main_paths kept, #144 dropped, ls-remote failure not a reject.
